summary_en: Dividend policy adopted: 20% payout ratio target. Initial dividend of 26 yen/share announced for FY6/27 (period ending Jun 2027), paid as final dividend. No interim dividend. Company rationale: record operating and net profits in FY6/26, equity ratio >50%, balance-sheet strength permitting sustainable distributions alongside growth investment.
title_en: Notice regarding change in dividend policy and dividend forecast (initial dividend) for fiscal year ending June 2027
translation_en_brief:
On 13 August 2026, WOLVES HAND held an extraordinary board meeting to adopt a new dividend policy and announce its inaugural dividend. The company stated that since its June 2024 IPO, its financial performance has remained robust, with FY6/26 (year ended June 2026) recording record revenue, operating profit, and net income. The equity ratio has exceeded 50%, and the company is constructing an integrated "One Health platform" across animal hospital operations, electronic medical records, CRO/SMO, R&D, medical devices, and biomaterials sectors, each generating synergistic returns. The company concluded that it can now balance growth investment with shareholder returns.

The new policy targets a 20% payout ratio based on sustainable and stable distributions. For FY6/27 (year ending June 2027), the company will pay an initial dividend of 26 yen per share as a final dividend (no interim payment). This represents the company's first dividend distribution since inception.
